Bajrang ban | path karai bajrang ban ki hanumat raksha karai pran ki | jay shri hanuman | tilak prastuti Watch the video song of "Ram Siya Yug Yug Ke Sathi Bichde Jate Hain" now!
Jab mata sita shri ram ke raj mahal ko chhorkar jati hain to dono ka hraday duhkh se bhara hota hai aur dono ek dusre se bichharne ke duhkh se dukhi hokar ek dusre ko dekhte rahte hain. is git men unke bichharne ka sara drishy dekhaya gaya hai.
